title: Shiki Specials
justification: AniList 10083 has 2 episodes of 23 minutes on 2011-05-25 and 2011-06-22. AniDB 7268 S1 'Twentieth Mourning and Offense' (2011-05-25) and S2 'Twenty-First Blood and Offense' (2011-06-22) are the two full-length extra episodes (20.5 and 21.5); TVDB 172941 0x01-0x02 carry the same titles on the same days, TMDB tv/36581 S0E1-2 likewise ('... and Malice (Episode 20.5 / 21.5)'). The web preview S3-S26 and 'Preview Episode 20.5/21.5' (S23, S25) are the Seishin monologues and are not this entry.
